subject: Surgeboard: Squad expansion & credentials runbook
thread_text:
From: Elena Soto <elena@surgeboard.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:12:00Z
Subject: Expansion: adding three squads and credentialing questions

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward with adding three more squads onto our account (support, internal tools, and mobile). Before procurement kicks off, I wanted to confirm a few operational items so we can scope the amendment and timeline: 

- Can we get separate API keys per squad (we'd like key-level quotas and rotation).
- Any recommended rollout pattern for not impacting latency for our production workloads?
- Estimated additional monthly spend for +3 squads at our current usage profile (we're currently on the Standard plan).
- Who should procurement contact for the amendment and DocuSign?

Attached is a brief list of new app names and owners. Can you propose a timeline? Ideally we'd have pilot keys for 'support' by Oct 20.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Engineering Ops
Surgeboard

---

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@surgeboard.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Expansion: adding three squads and credentialing questions

Hi Elena — great to hear, and congrats on the rapid roll decision. High level answers below and next steps at the bottom. I copied a couple folks to help scope the rollout and contract work.

Quick answers:
- Yes: we can issue separate API keys per squad and map them to namespaces for billing/usage.
- Rollout pattern: we recommend a staged activation (pilot → expanded pilot → full-onboard) with prefix/KV caching warmed per key to avoid cold-token latency. I outline a 3-week pilot plan below.
- Cost: rough incremental estimate is in the MAP (attached) — ballpark +18–25% over current spend depending on burst patterns and caching effectiveness. We'll produce a tighter estimate after you share 7 days of representative traffic.
- Procurement contact: Kimberly will be the point for contract amendment and DocuSign.

Pilot timeline (proposal):
1) Week 1 (Oct 13–20): Issue pilot keys for Support (1 key). Run 7 days of canonical traffic.
2) Week 2 (Oct 21–27): Add Internal Tools (staged traffic) and enable prefetched KV caches for frequent prefixes.
3) Week 3 (Oct 28–Nov 3): Add Mobile, ramp to production if SLOs hold.

Action items for Surgeboard:
- Share 7 days of token-level traffic for the three apps (we'll accept anonymized logs).
- Confirm procurement contact and preferred PO/DocuSign flow.

Ben — can you confirm the key mapping template and any engineering caveats? Monica — can you draft an onboarding runbook for the staged activation? Kimberly — can you confirm the amendment path and a target signature date?

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena@surgeboard.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T12:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Expansion: adding three squads and credentialing questions

Elena — technical follow-up. A few pragmatic notes for the pilot and rollout so you can plan: 

- Key design: we recommend one key per squad plus a read-only key pattern for analytics. Keys map to a namespace: your\"support\", \"internal-tools\", \"mobile\" namespaces.
- Quotas: we can set per-key token rate limits and burst windows to protect tiered capacity.
- Rotation: automated rotation is available; we'll provide a rotation script for your infra team (attached as a template).
- Caching: to keep latency stable, pre-warm prefix caches for the most common prompt prefixes during the pilot. We can share initial cache keys once we see sample traffic.

Attachments: key-mapping-template.csv (fields: key_id, namespace, owner_email, rate_limit, burst_window)

If you want, we can run a quick smoke test (5k tokens) on Oct 19 to validate latency before pilot starts.

- Ben

---

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@surgeboard.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T08:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Expansion: adding three squads and credentialing questions

Hi Elena — I've drafted a short onboarding runbook and checklist for the staged activation. Key items below; I'll drop the full runbook into the Drive link once Ben's traffic sample arrives.

Onboarding runbook (summary):
- Pre-pilot: Exchange sanitized 7-day traffic sample (Sergio/B en). Complete security questionnaire (if required).
- Pilot support key (Oct 13–20): Issue key, enable monitoring dashboard, run smoke test (Ben).
- Monitoring & rollback criteria: 95th pctl latency target + error-rate threshold at 0.5% — automatic rollback to previous model variant if exceeded.
- Escalation path: CS on-call -> Account Eng -> Product Infra (contacts included in doc).
- Post-pilot: Contract amendment accepted -> bulk key issuance and onboarding for remaining squads.

I can run a 30-minute onboarding workshop with your infra team on Oct 12 to walk through rotation scripts and dashboards. Suggested attendees: infra lead, platform engineer, security.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment references: surgeboard_mutual_action_plan_v3.xlsx (MAP) — contains pricing estimates and the proposed signature timeline.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>

Hi Elena — Kimberly from Legal/RevOps. Quick notes on the contract path so procurement can proceed: 

- Amendment type: \"add-on seats / app bundles\" amendment. We will append an addendum to your existing MSA.
- Target signature date: We can aim for Oct 25 DocuSign execution if procurement returns a PO by Oct 18.
- Pricing confirmation: The MAP shows the +18–25% range. I'll convert that to a line-item amendment with a not-to-exceed upper bound to align to your procurement needs.
- Data residency/controls: No additional clauses required for these squads beyond existing terms, per our review. If your security team requests an updated SOC evidence set, we can provide it via the compliance portal.

Attached: redwood_amendment_draft.docx (initial draft for procurement). Please let me know if procurement wants an SOW or a single-line amendment.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
